'''Shramar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was controlled by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

[[File:Battle_of_Shramar.jpg|thumb|left|100px|The [[Battle of Shramar]]]]
At some point prior to the war, advance scouts of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] seeded the planet with both [[lambent]]s and [[Muur (food)|muur]] with the intention of harvesting them at a later date. During the war, it was the site of the [[Battle of Shramar]].
